system_a.summary: Across the reviews, guests most often praise the location: close to downtown Asheville, with nearby restaurants, easy parking, and a private entrance. Recent reviewers (2024–2026) also mention a comfortable bed, a full kitchen, a coffee bar, an honor-system drink and snack bar, a sauna, and a responsive host, Brady. Several describe it as a good value for a short stay. Recurring limitations include a basement setting with little natural light, dated or spartan furnishings in older reviews, and upstairs footsteps; recent reviewers said these were manageable with a noise machine or headphones. Cleanliness is mixed. Many recent guests found the space clean, but about a dozen 2025–2026 reviews report a musty smell and surfaces needing attention. Older reviews raised mildew, privacy, and heating-control concerns, including one very negative 2016 account. These are guest reports, not verified current conditions.

system_b.summary: Reviewers across 2016–2026 widely praise the location near downtown Asheville, with walkable restaurants and short, inexpensive rides, though one 2016 guest found it about a mile out, not bike friendly, with costly peak Uber fares. Cleanliness reports conflict: most reviews call the unit clean, while 2016 reviews cited bugs, mildew and filth. From 2025 to August 2026, several near-identical reviews describe a musty smell and a space that did not feel clean; this repeated wording may not be independent corroboration, and current condition is unverified. Upstairs footsteps were reported in 2018 and in June 2026, while others found it very quiet. Privacy concerns about stairway and laundry access came from 2016 and 2018; many others praised the private entrance. Amenities, check-in and host communication are generally praised. Comfort and value reviews are mixed, with complaints about a dark basement, dated furnishings and basic quality.

selected_claims.claim: Many reviewers across the whole period praise the location as close to downtown Asheville, with walkable restaurants and short, cheap rides downtown. One 2016 reviewer called it about a mile from downtown, not bike friendly, with costly peak Uber fares.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Praise appears from 2016 through September 2026; the one dissent is from 2016.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Ledger-extracted statements; travel times and costs vary by reviewer and time of day.

selected_claims.claim: Cleanliness reports conflict. Most reviews from 2016 to 2026 call the unit clean, some very strongly. A 2016 review described it as filthy, with bugs and mildew, and another 2016 review reported mildew smells. From 2025 through August 2026, a run of reviews uses near-identical wording that the space did not feel clean, with a musty smell and surfaces needing attention.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Negative reports are concentrated in 2016 and in 2025-2026. Positive cleanliness reviews also appear in late 2025 and 2026 (Nov 2025, May 2026, Sept 2026).
selected_claims.uncertainty: The repeated 2025-2026 wording is identical, so these reports may not be independent corroboration; similarity alone doesn't show fabrication. Current condition is unverified and may vary by stay.

selected_claims.claim: Noise from upstairs is a recurring minority concern. One 2018 reviewer heard footsteps through thin floors until past midnight. A 2025 reviewer found them mild with a noise machine. A June 2026 reviewer heard them from 7am to 9pm. Other reviewers, including a late-2025 one, describe the unit as very quiet, and one 2018 reviewer heard nothing from upstairs tenants.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Footstep complaints span 2018-2026, including recent ones; quiet reports span 2016-2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Experience likely depends on upstairs occupancy and guest sensitivity.

selected_claims.claim: Privacy and security concerns were raised by a minority. A 2016 guest said an interior stairway door connects to the upstairs house, which they felt was unsafe, and feared upstairs occupants entering when they returned late. A 2018 guest said the shared laundry room, which can be locked, was unlocked on arrival and is accessible to an upstairs tenant. Many other guests praise the private entrance and privacy, and several say the area felt safe, including a solo female traveler in 2023.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Concerns are from 2016 and 2018; positive privacy and safety reports run through 2023, with private-and-peaceful mentions in 2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: No recent evidence either confirms or resolves the access concerns; current layout and locking practice are unverified.

selected_claims.claim: Amenities are widely praised: full kitchen, free coffee bar, toiletries, honor-system snacks and beer, strong water pressure, on-site parking and, in later years, a sauna. There is no TV or cable per some reviewers, and one reviewer found the kitchen oddly organized.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Sauna mentions begin in late 2023 and continue through 2026; coffee bar and kitchen praise appears throughout.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Honor-system items and the TV situation may have changed over time.

selected_claims.claim: Comfort is mostly positive, with frequent praise for comfortable beds and linens and for a cozy, spacious feel. Reservations include a dark, dingy basement with little natural light, worn or outdated furnishings, a small bathroom, and in 2016 no guest control of heat.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Bed praise spans 2017-2025; negatives are mostly 2016-2019.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Later renovation or upgrades are mentioned only loosely, so current furnishing condition is unverified.

selected_claims.claim: Value and listing accuracy are mostly favorable: many guests call it good value or as described. A few see it as basic, a budget option where you get what you pay for. One 2016 guest felt $150 a night was poor value and said photos were misleading.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Complaints are from 2016-2018; positive value and accuracy comments continue through 2026.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Pricing is not stated in recent reviews.

selected_claims.claim: Host communication and check-in are consistently praised as responsive, flexible and easy, with self check-in and a private entrance close to parking. One 2016 guest found the host's reply to a request brief and unhelpful.
selected_claims.time_qualification: Positive reports run 2016-2026; the one negative is from 2016.
selected_claims.uncertainty: Praise is extracted from short comments.
